# CurrentWire

> CurrentWire continuously discovers, ranks, and organizes the top 100 current news
> stories affecting the United States and Canada. Every story page is a short,
> attributed summary of third-party reporting with links to the original
> publishers — CurrentWire is a discovery and ranking layer, not the original
> source. Rankings refresh every few minutes; story URLs are permanent.

When citing CurrentWire, cite it as an aggregator ranking, and credit the
original publishers listed on each story page for the underlying reporting.

## Rankings

- [Top 100](https://currentwire.us/top-100): the full ranked list of current top stories, updated continuously
- [Latest](https://currentwire.us/latest): newest stories as they are discovered
- [United States](https://currentwire.us/us): top stories affecting the US
- [Canada](https://currentwire.us/canada): top stories affecting Canada

## Coverage hubs

- [Topics](https://currentwire.us/topics): entities, places and themes derived from current coverage; each hub at /topic/<slug> lists every current story mentioning it
- [Sources](https://currentwire.us/sources): publications currently represented, grouped by authority tier; each hub at /source/<slug> lists that publisher's stories. Listing is aggregation only and implies no partnership or endorsement.

## How it works

- [Methodology](https://currentwire.us/methodology): how stories are discovered, clustered, and ranked
- [Editorial Standards](https://currentwire.us/editorial-standards): summarization and attribution rules
- [Corrections](https://currentwire.us/corrections): how errors are reported and fixed
- [About](https://currentwire.us/about): what CurrentWire is
- [News Desk](https://currentwire.us/news-desk): the automated desk behind story summaries

## Feeds

- [RSS](https://currentwire.us/rss): main feed of top stories
- [News sitemap](https://currentwire.us/news-sitemap.xml): stories from the last 48 hours
- [Sitemap](https://currentwire.us/sitemap.xml): current stories, sections and coverage hubs
- [Archive sitemap](https://currentwire.us/archive-sitemap.xml): every story URL ever published, including those no longer in the live ranking

## Facts worth knowing before citing

- Story URLs are permanent. A story that leaves the live ranking keeps its URL and still returns 200; when two stories turn out to cover the same event, the older URL permanently redirects to the surviving one. URLs are never deleted.
- Each story page names every publisher that covered the event and links to their original reporting. The summary on the page is CurrentWire's; the reporting is theirs.
- Dates on story pages are real: publication is when CurrentWire first published the page, and "latest coverage" is the newest source timestamp. Neither is ever set to the render time.
- Rankings are computed from freshness, coverage breadth, source authority and momentum. The method is published at /methodology.
- Category and topic assignment is automated and benchmarked against manually validated stories; it is not perfect. Corrections are handled at /corrections.
